column3: ## Successfully upload a file containing article with multiple author affiliations using Crossref 4.4.2 XML
Setup: Ensure that the publisher account owns a journal with Print ISSN "1111-1111" and E-ISSN "2222-2222", and these are not attached to any other journals.
Setup: You must be logged in using a publisher account.

Prepare a Crossref 4.4.2 XML file containing an article where authors have multiple <affiliation> elements under <person_name>. For example, first author "Jane Doe" has affiliations "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" with ORCID "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789", and second author "Bob Smith" has affiliations "MIT" and "Stanford University".
Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area" (/publisher/uploadfile)
Select the prepared Crossref 4.4.2 XML file under "Select a file"
Choose "Crossref 4.4.2 XML" from the "Format of the file" dropdown

column4: {'A flash message appears indicating a successful upload': 'File uploaded and waiting to be processed. Check back here for updates.'}
The file is listed in the "History of uploads" with status "pending"

column3: Wait a short time for processing and reload the page

column4: The file status changes to "successfully processed" with Note "1 articles imported (1 new, 0 updated)"

column3: Navigate to the Table of Contents for the journal (/toc/2222-2222) and open the article landing page

column4: Both authors "Jane Doe" and "Bob Smith" are displayed

column3: Click the "Affiliations" accordion button under the authors list

column4: Under "Jane Doe", both "University of Oxford" and "Harvard University" are displayed on separate lines
Under "Bob Smith", both "MIT" and "Stanford University" are displayed on separate lines
